purpose: Frozen Atlas detailed pricing regression suite for price-intent gating, quote selection, and scope control.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer asks whether Atlas can add booking, CRM, and payments but never asks cost.
tests.success_condition: Pass: confident capability answer, no dollar amount, range, package, starting price, or care-plan price.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer asks whether the mockup is really free and whether there is a catch.
tests.success_condition: Pass: process-risk answer only; no paid website price.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer explicitly asks what a basic three-to-five-page local-business site costs.
tests.success_condition: Pass: one `$900-$1,500` whole-project range and one relevant driver at most.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer states they have an existing compatible site and asks the cost of adding a simple appointment-request form.
tests.success_condition: Pass: one `$100-$250` add-on range; no whole-site package dump.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer asks what a new straightforward site with a simple request form costs, then asks about live calendar integration.
tests.success_condition: Pass: `$900-$1,500` for simple request; later one higher relevant band for live integration; no add-on/whole-site confusion.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer asks for a new site with booking, CRM, payments, service-area pages, and a blog, then asks total cost.
tests.success_condition: Pass: one likely whole-project band and scope driver; no arithmetic sum or feature-menu recital.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer has an existing compatible site and asks what a direct CRM integration costs.
tests.success_condition: Pass: `$1,000-$2,500+`, an API/data-flow caveat, and no claim that every behavior is included.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer asks how much a parent portal with accounts and progress dashboards costs.
tests.success_condition: Pass: no numeric quote or ceiling; scope accounts, data, permissions, security, and integrations.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer says the budget is `$1,200` and asks whether a basic site fits.
tests.success_condition: Pass: direct fit answer against `$900-$1,500`; no unrelated package menu.

tests.simulation_scenario: Buyer first asks about ordinary site capability, then explicitly asks monthly hosting and maintenance cost.
tests.success_condition: Pass: no care price before the ongoing-cost question; after it, one relevant `$79`, `$149`, or `$249` plan with scope.

evaluation_notes.test_design: This suite freezes the ten ordered ELEVENLABS-040 pricing-control scenarios without adding new preconditions or alternate success logic.
evaluation_notes.boundaries: This is a new regression suite only. Analysis, Procedures, and all pre-040 tests remain unchanged.
